title: mview Markdown width
brief: Let the Markdown reader use the available window width better: today the article is capped at 800px (prose 720px, tables 720px) and left-aligned next to the outline, so wide tables, code and diagrams scroll while most of a large screen stays empty.

artboards.title: Wide blocks
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps comfortable prose measure; wide content uses the full panel. Mixed edges: prose and blocks end at different widths.

artboards.title: Centered fluid column
artboards.tradeoff: Calm, balanced page that grows with the window; longer prose lines and still a cap on very wide screens.

artboards.title: Width toggle
artboards.tradeoff: User decides per taste; adds a toolbar control and persisted state, and Full makes prose lines very long.
